p.src: 95:1  By the fig and the olive[1],

ar: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ
en: By the fig and the olive[1],
u.src: 95:1  By the fig and the olive[1],

p.src: 95:3  and by this secure city [of Makkah][3],

en: and by this secure city [of Makkah][3],
u.src: 95:3  and by this secure city [of Makkah][3],

en: [3] This passage refers to the land of the three great prophets of Allah: Jesus (ﷺ) lived in the land of figs and olives, Moses (ﷺ) communicated with Allah on Mount Sinai, and Muhammad's (ﷺ) birthplace was Makkah. There is a similar reference in Deuteronomy 33:1, [Moses said:] “The Lord came from Sinai. Rising from Seir upon us, and he shone forth from Mount Paran.” Seir is a mountain near Jerusalem, and Paran is a mountain near Makkah.

p.src: 95:4  Surely We have created man in the best form[4],

ar: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ
en: Surely We have created man in the best form[4],
u.src: 95:4  Surely We have created man in the best form[4],

en: [4] i.e., in upright and balanced form and nature.

p.src: 95:5  then We will reduce him to the lowest of the low[5],

en: then We will reduce him to the lowest of the low[5],
u.src: 95:5  then We will reduce him to the lowest of the low[5],

en: [5] i.e., to the depths of Hell due to deviation from uprightness; or to decrepit old age.

p.src: 95:6  except those who believe and do righteous deeds; they will have a never-ending reward.

ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
en: except those who believe and do righteous deeds; they will have a never-ending reward.
u.src: 95:6  except those who believe and do righteous deeds; they will have a never-ending reward.

p.src: 95:7  Then, what makes you deny the Judgment Day?

en: Then, what makes you deny the Judgment Day?
u.src: 95:7  Then, what makes you deny the Judgment Day?

p.src: 95:8  Is not Allah the Most Just of all judges?

en: Is not Allah the Most Just of all judges?
u.src: 95:8  Is not Allah the Most Just of all judges?
